title: The wrong way: forgetting the parentheses when renaming
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload.data mapObject ((v, k, i) -> { k: v })

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload.data mapObject ((v, k, i) -> { k: v })

explanation.approach: Every entry lands under the literal key `k`, because the bare identifier was never turned into an expression. The labels lookup does not even run.
